rationale: Price at $8.32 has decisively breached the $8.29 invalidation and reclaimed VWAP ($8.27) with seven consecutive higher closes off the $7.96 low, mechanically invalidating the weak-bounce-continuation thesis; holding a stopped-out short against a squeeze with a $600 remaining loss budget is unwarranted. The evidence for flipping long is not meaningfully stronger than going flat — the bounce is occurring on declining volume with no new headline, directly into HOD resistance at $8.40, and against a still risk-off tape (SPY -0.64%, VIXY +2.66%) — so exiting to zero exposure without re-engaging is the correct move.
